rows.en: Baio: "...What should I do...? I..."
Bio: "Thank you for the compliment.
...Now, about my proposal...
That technology you researched long ago, Brother.
Use it."
Baio: "Long ago?"
Bio: "Don't play dumb.
You know what I mean. The 'Code 3'..."
Baio: "!! How do you know about that...?"
Bio: "Well, just a little..."
Baio: "You broke into my database?!
But to get through that protection...
I didn't expect you to have that kind of talent."
Bio: "It wasn't me. It was Celea here."
Baio: "What?! That horny bimbo?!"
Celea: "Really, Baio,
isn't that a bit much?"
Baio: "Hmph! Everyone has some special talent, but...
You, a skilled hacker..."
Bio: "You don't question the quality of your own protection, do you?"
Baio: "Hmph! Of course not. It's a top-level
security system. The only people who could get through it
would be Murk in his prime, Ymir of the Holy Land,
and perhaps Celica of Agarthia.
More importantly, no one would buy that now.
No country would turn public opinion against itself
just to pursue military power."
Bio: "But there is one. Very close by.
Heh heh... Don't you see? Right here."
Baio: "What are you pointing at the floor for...?
!! D-Don't tell me..."
Bio: "Yes. Our own Zigrim.
President Horem, to be precise."
Baio: "Impossible! President Horem was elected with support from the party that wiped out 'Code 3',
the National Labor Party.
And his father, too..."
Bio: "Well, just because that's true of the people around him,
doesn't mean it's true of him.
It seems that, in a different way from General Growster,
he wants to leave his name in history, too."
Baio: "No! Absolutely not!
I was against that plan in the first place.
Besides, we don't have the material...!! You don't mean..."
Bio: "You've finally caught on.
Yes. Use that woman from another world, Melissa."
Baio: "D-Don't be ridiculous!"
Bio: "Then are you willing to let her go?
At this rate... No, perhaps her memories have already
returned.
If so, I don't think she'll stay here.
She'll surely return to her companions.
Somewhere you'll never be able to reach her, Brother. Forever."
Baio: "..."
Bio: "Listen, Brother.
I'm sure she really wants to stay with you, too.
That research can make it happen. With you forever.
And she'll be freed from the shackles of a physical body,
becoming a free existence for all eternity.
Only you can do that for her, Brother..."
Baio: "B-But..."
Bio: "For a woman, happiness means
living with the person who loves her most.
Is there anyone who loves her more than you do, Brother?"
Baio: "No one! I love her the most... Oh."
Bio: "There's no need to be embarrassed now.
...Then there's no reason to hesitate.
You're the only one who can make her happy, Brother..."
Baio: "No... I can't bear to let Melissa go...
Rather than let her go... Rather than let that happen..."
Miyasco: "Incoming communication from the president."
Celica: "Put him through."
Horem: "...I suppose I should say I'm impressed.
Forgive me, but I honestly didn't expect you to be this capable."
Celica: "...You'll keep your promise, won't you?"
Horem: "Yes. But I have one condition."
Arthur: "So it came to that after all."
Horem: "Maki Theora Tres
should be aboard your ship.
I want her 03Kー01 recording crystal,
and the data Liebhofen recorded this time,
handed over to us.
I wouldn't exactly call it compensation,
but I will provide you with a little information."
Celica: "That's a very convenient proposal for you."
Horem: "I do want to keep my promise, after all..."
Maki: "There's no way I'll accept such a ridiculous condition!
What would I have helped you for, then?!
Give her back right now, or I'll make this public!"
Horem: "You're contradicting yourself.
You don't intend to hand over the data, do you?
Then even if I return Ymir,
you'll make it public. If it'll be made public either way,
I can't return her."
Arthur: "He has complete control of the situation."
Xiujian: "...We'll have to accept his terms."
Touya: "Tch... So we do whatever he says."
Celica: "...All right. We'll accept your conditions.
But Ymir is released first."
Horem: "Of course.
I'll send someone over, then..."
Celica: "...Now, then."
Maki: "Ugh... I-I just remembered something I need to do...
W-Well, bye!"
Celica: "Derock!"
Derock: "Understooood."
Yamato: "M-Meow?! What was that movement?!"
Maki: "What?! No way... Again?!"
Reisuke: "Beep-beep..."
Touya: "...Is his body full of gas or something?"
Xiujian: "Even the old masters back home couldn't manage
movements so fluid and unpredictable.
To think there was such a formidable master of physical technique..."
Miyasco: "The mercenaries' Armored Mech is arriving."
Celica: "We should avoid Hangar One, just in case."
Miyasco: "Understood. I'll guide it to Hangar Two."
Vel: "We're here, miss."
Ymir: "Y-Yes."
Jono: "..."
Ymir: "Um..."
Jono: "..."
Ymir: "I've never had anyone say something like that to me before...
Um... I don't know how to put this, but...
Things like this really should... Um..."
Jono: "...Is there a man you love?"
Ymir: "What?! Y-Yes..."
Jono: "...I see."
Ymir: "Um... I'm truly sorry..."
Jono: "No... I understand."
Ymir: "Well, then... Goodbye."
Vel: "Aww, what a waste..."
Jono: "..."
Vel: "Hey, what's with that gloomy face...?
You... were serious?"
Jono: "...I don't fall for people as a joke."
Vel: "That's just like you. Well, don't let it get you down.
Half the people in this world are women, after all.
I'll introduce you to a better woman sometime."
Jono: "...I'll wait without getting my hopes up."
Touya: "Ymir!"
Ai: "I'm glad you're safe."
Ymir: "Everyone, I'm sorry I worried you.
All this for me..."
Aurelie: "Of course we did. If you abandon your companions,
you're finished as a human being."
Touya: "Were you all right?"
Ymir: "Yes... Thank you."
Vel: "Sorry to interrupt your reunion, but we'd like to finish the job
quickly, too. Will you cooperate?"
Celica: "...This is Reisuke's recording crystal."
Vel: "That's it. Now we need this ship's records."
Celica: "The bridge is this way."
Celica: "I see... You're the one who made those decoys."
Vel: "...Then you're the one who...?
Huh, to think such a pretty young lady
was the maker of that.
Celica Laniard Mestina...
It seems the rumors were true."
Celica: "I don't know what rumors you mean, but you're quite good yourself.
Will you tell me your name?"
Vel: "Vel Dresna."
Celica: "Vel. I'll remember that."
Vel: "I'm honored. ...Well, that does it.
I haven't touched anything else. Want to check?"
Celica: "No need. I was watching behind you."
Vel: "Heh... You really are frighteningly promising.
Maybe someone like you will be the trigger
for civilization's advancement... Well, it's nothing to do with me.
I'll be going, then. Our job's done."
Horem: "...I'm sorry for making such selfish demands.
I would rather not have a scandal come to light
at this point, either.
...Now, as promised, I'll tell you something
you should find useful. You may already know this,
but in Zigrim's Armored Mechs, ≪Ze=Ode≫'s technology
is what's used. Well, Growster
apparently didn't know that. As for the supplier, Lyle
Enroad has been particularly busy lately,
and is trying to pull out of Zigrim.
No, to be precise, you could say he's already pulled out."
Clovis: "Why would you betray your own country...?
Now that you've said it yourself,
you can't talk your way out of it later."
Horem: "That wounds me. I love this country,
and the world. You aren't the only ones who regard ≪Ze=Ode≫
as a threat.
And I won't be troubled if this becomes public.
After all, Growster acted on his own."
Celica: "So it's ammunition to bring down a rival."
Horem: "Heh heh heh... Now, this is
the real point. It seems ≪Ze=Ode≫
is plotting something.
I don't know exactly what, but in Agarthia's capital,
multiple reactions have been observed.
And we've received information that ≪Dawn of an Era≫ is planning
a large-scale terrorist attack in that capital.
Wouldn't it be less natural
to think the two were completely unrelated?"
Fain: "The capital?!"
Celica: "We've detected ≪Ze=Ode≫ reactions there before,
so it's quite possible..."
Horem: "That's all I have to say. We may meet again,
but for today, I'll take my leave...
Oh, I forgot something important.
...Ymir."
Ymir: "Y-Yes?"
Horem: "Please remember this much.
You are not as insignificant
as you think.
If you ever feel you're about to be crushed by your own destiny,
please come to see me at any time.
Until then, this is goodbye for a while."
Ymir: "What does that...?"
Touya: "Oh, he cut us off."
Celica: "What does he mean?"
Ymir: "I don't know..."
Arthur: "If that's why he abducted Ymir,
then perhaps Prince Cain's presence here
is connected somehow...?"
Celica: "I'd rather not think so, but... that's the reasonable conclusion."
Touya: "Do you know that Cain guy?"
Celica: "More or less. Five years ago, he came to study at the Agarthian Royal Academy,
and we studied together there for two years.
Tix in particular looked up to him. The two of them
were closer than real brothers and were always together.
Then, three years ago, he suddenly disappeared..."
Ymir: "And today, he appeared before us."
Kasumi: "Eek!"
Touya: "Ymir! H-Hey, are you all right?!"
Ymir: "I-I'm sorry... Now that I can relax..."
Miyasco: "I think it's psychological,
but we should run an examination, just in case.
Touya, would you help me?"
Touya: "R-Right."
Ymir: "I-I'm all right... I can walk... by myself..."
Touya: "I can't hear you... Hup!"
Ymir: "Eek! H-Hey..."
Touya: "Come on, let's go."
Ymir: "...Are you all right? Um... Am I... heavy...?"
Touya: "I-I'm fine!"
Ymir: "...Thank you, Touya."
Kasumi: "..."
Yamato: "Being popular is hard, isn't it?"
Touya: "Shut up."
Ai: "...So, how is she?"
Gabon: "Well, now that she's safe, all that tension has finally
given way. She's all right. A good rest should have her recovered soon."
Kasumi: "Thank goodness..."
Miyasco: "She's sleeping under medication now,
so please visit her later."
Touya: "I see..."
Yamato: "Let's come back later, then."
Ai: "Yes. We need to let her rest for now."
Touya: "Yeah. Take care of her, then."
Gabon: "Leave it to me."
Touya: "Hm? That's Xiujian..."
Ai: "What are you doing? Aren't you going back to the bridge?"
Touya: "Go on ahead."
Kasumi: "What's wrong?"
Touya: "There's something on my mind."
Ai: "...Don't tell me you're thinking of going back to Ymir..."
Touya: "It's not that."
Ai: "...Well, fine.
It doesn't look like you're lying. But we'll be deciding what to do next,
so come back soon."
Touya: "I know."
Kasumi: "See you later, then."
Touya: "Yeah."
Touya: "Hey. What are you doing here?"
Xiujian: "..."
Touya: "Look, it's not good to keep it all bottled up.
Even I can at least listen.
Though I might not be much help."
Xiujian: "..."
Touya: "...*sigh* Well, all right.
Whenever you feel like it..."
Xiujian: "...You're a busybody."
Touya: "Maybe."
Xiujian: "Heh... I admire that side of you.
I could never do the same..."
Touya: "...It is about that woman Melissa, isn't it?"
Xiujian: "...Yes. Melissa and I
first met two and a half years ago...
Back then, I'd just arrived in Agarthia,
and I was confused.
I clashed with Clovis, Arthur and the others almost every day.
You could say I was isolated.
The person who smiled and spoke to me
was Melissa.
It's thanks to Melissa that I am who I am now,
you could say."
Touya: "And something more than trust
grew between you..."
Xiujian: "...Yes.
Melissa accepted my feelings.
But that time, during that exercise, Melissa..."
Touya: "An exercise?"
Xiujian: "A mock exercise with Spirit Mechs.
Simulating actual combat. During that exercise,
we encountered a Zigrim special forces unit.
We were near a village, so we tried to move away,
but we didn't make it in time, and battle broke out...
It was my first real battle.
Melissa protected the village while also supporting me.
But I made a mistake, and then... she took the hit for me.
After that, I don't remember what I did.
When I came to, the battle was over, and half the village was destroyed.
Ahti was barely holding its original shape..."
Touya: "But you didn't think Melissa was dead."
Xiujian: "No. And just as I thought, she was alive.
She was alive. But with her memory gone, I
couldn't save her again."
Touya: "I don't think that's true.
At least she remembered your name.
Isn't it your turn to help Melissa this time?"
Xiujian: "...Help... Heh... You're right.
This time, it's my turn to help Melissa."
Touya: "I'll help however I can."
Xiujian: "...Thank you."
Touya: "All right. Shall we go to the bridge, then?
They'll probably be discussing what to do next."
Xiujian: "Yes."
Touya: "...Are you giving up?
Is that all your feelings amount to?"
Xiujian: "..."
Touya: "...Don't give up.
You're the one who has to help Melissa.
Not anyone else, Xiujian. You."
Xiujian: "...Help... Heh... You're right.
This time, it's my turn to help Melissa."
Touya: "I'll help however I can."
Xiujian: "...Thank you."
Touya: "All right. Shall we go to the bridge, then?
They'll probably be discussing what to do next."
Xiujian: "Yes."
Arthur: "Now, about our plans from here..."
Fain: "Ow, ow, ow..."
Maki: "Honestly! My big scoop!
My Roguewar Prize!"
Touya: "...What's going on?"
Kasumi: "She still hasn't got over having to hand over the data,
and Fain is..."
Maki: "Take that, and that, and that!"
Fain: "S-Shtop it..."
Arthur: "Um, Maki? If possible, could you check
whether the president's information was correct...?"
Maki: "...What?!"
Arthur: "Oh, no... Um...
I was hoping... you might help us again..."
Maki: "Like I care! Why don't you look into it yourselves?!"
Fain: "Yooow!!"
Celica: "...W-Well, given what happened before,
let's head back to the capital for now."
Arthur: "And we should tell Lady Ivel about Ymir's
successful rescue, along with the terrorist threat.
If she reports it to His Highness Lodis through that channel,
perhaps something can be done."
Celica: "Right. Miyasco... is in the infirmary.
Sisk, could you handle the communication?"
Sisk: "What?! May I call His Highness?!"
Celica: "Nooo! The Holy Land. We can't contact my brother directly,
because the transmission could be intercepted."
Sisk: "Okaaay..."
Cain: "...Was that really all right?"
Horem: "Yes. It's a little disappointing,
but even if I forced her to stay in that state,
I couldn't get her to open her heart."
Cain: "Then why not use the results of that plan?"
Horem: "An artificially created personality cannot guide people."
Cain: "...Do you honestly think I'd believe that?
Your real aim is her blood,
and its constituent factors, isn't it?"
Horem: "...Who knows? Whatever could you mean?
Well, I'll let them have the glory this time."
Cain: "You're very relaxed... We'll need them to deal with ≪Ze=Ode≫
either way, after all.
I'll go prod Agarthia a little, then."
Horem: "What a misfortune for the man you've singled out.
But he's your friend, isn't he? Are you really sure?"
Cain: "A friend? Heh heh heh...
Anyone who thinks they really have friends is an idiot."
